events.title: Intramural Pool League
events.description:
Chalk your cue and bring your best shot to the Intramural Pool League! Open to players of all skill levels, this casual and competitive league is the perfect place to meet new people, sharpen your game, and enjoy friendly competition. Whether you're a seasoned player or just learning the ropes, all are welcome.

Matches are played weekly in a relaxed environment, with a focus on sportsmanship, fun, and community. Teams or individuals can sign up, and equipment is provided if needed. Join us for a great time, good vibes, and some solid 8-ball action!

events.title: Opportunities in Agriculture
events.description: The Dickinson State University Department of Agriculture and Technical Studies initiated the Opportunities in Agriculture event because we want our students to be able to learn more about the agricultural industry in the region, network with the businesses/agencies in the region, and make connections for future opportunities after graduation (including graduate school). This event also serves as a forum for our seniors to present their senior capstone projects, which includes both an oral and poster presentation at the event. All DSU students, especially agriculture, natural sciences/environmental health, and business students, are invited to come to the event. This event is free and open to the public. We welcome and encourage the public to attend. The event consists of a keynote presentation, career fair, and senior capstone presentations.

events.title: Junie B. in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells!
events.description:
Blue Hawk Theatre Guild Presents

Junie B. Jones in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells! Get ready to kick off the holiday season with laughter, heart, and plenty of holiday cheer! Blue Hawk Theatre Guild, featuring Dickinson State University students alongside talented community members, proudly presents Junie B. Jones in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells!.

Junie B. Jones is excited about the holiday season and the Secret Santa gift exchange at school. But when she draws her class tattletale, May, as the recipient of her gift, Junie faces an important question: Will she embrace the true spirit of Christmas, kindness, and goodwill? Filled with hilarious moments, memorable characters, and an uplifting message, this family-friendly production is the perfect way to begin your holiday celebrations.

Join us Thanksgiving weekend for this festive theatrical tradition! Performance DatesFriday – Thanksgiving Weekend 7:00pm

Saturday – Thanksgiving Weekend 7:00pm

Sunday – Thanksgiving Weekend 2:00 pm

AdmissionAdults: $10

Students (K–12): $5

Free for Dickinson State University students, faculty, and staff with a valid DSU ID.

Bring the whole family and celebrate the season with Blue Hawk Theatre Guild as we share the joy, laughter, and heart of one of children's literature's most beloved characters!

events.title: Home Alone
events.description: After premiering in 1990, Home Alone (PG) from director Chris Columbus and writer John Hughes became a Christmas classic. The story about a dysfunctional wealthy family is, at its core, a film to remind us all about the true meaning of the season: family, and being grateful for the warmth and joy that comes with having people who love you in your life. At the same time, the slapstick comedy of Kevin defending his house from hapless robbers a la Tom and Jerry or the Roadrunner and Wile E. Coyote steals the show. Come and share the Christmas cookies with this Neverending Nineties selection.

events.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
events.description: The stop-motion film The Nightmare Before Christmas (PG) has become a Christmas classic -- or Halloween classic -- the debate continues! Based on a story and characters by Tim Burton and directed by Henry Selick, this 1993 film spawned a resurgence of stop motion movies. Full of imaginative creatures, memorable songs, and a story about self-discovery, the animation is as groundbreaking as the story, helping it stand out in a crowded holiday season. Enjoy the film for the first time, or come for the umpteenth time and join in a sing-a-long to Danny Elfman's music. Share Christmas cookies with this Animated Nights selection.

events.title: The Matrix
events.description: A movie that changed popular culture, the movie industry, how movies are made, and even how people talk to each other. The 1999 film The Matrix (R) from directors Lana Wachowski and Lilly Wachowski was released without much fanfare, only to become a sensation of special effects, action scenes, and haunting mindtrips. In our age filled with increasing concerns over artificial intelligence, the film informed how an entire generation saw the internet and everything connected to it. Come for the groundbreaking action, and stay for the existential horrors. Escape the Finals with this Unsung Superheroes film.

events.title: 2027 DSU Alumni & Friends Caribbean Cruise
events.description:
The DSU Heritage Foundation is excited to partner with Kay at All American Travel to offer a 7‑night Caribbean cruise, January 10–17, 2027, departing from Miami aboard the Norwegian Aqua. Enjoy stops in the Dominican Republic, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and the Bahamas, this trip offers adventure and impact: as more alumni and friends participate, more funds are raised for the Blue Hawk Scholarship Fund, with a goal of providing 4 new full scholarships or more. *Pricing begins at $2500.00/person  *pricing will vary depending on personal selections Package includes:All meals plus 3 specialty dining meals

Beverage package

$50 per port shore excursion credit

$100 on board credit

150 minutes of free Wi‑Fi per person

Balcony stateroom

Airfare from Bismarck (restrictions apply; other departure cities available)

Additional Notes:Pricing varies based on personal selections

Flights included (optional)

Military and teacher discounts available

Optional travel insurance offered

Register before May 31, 2026 for best pricing (prices subject to change after 5/31/2026)

Registration closes September 1, 2026

Payment & Deposit Information:For the best pricing and availability, we recommend booking early

A deposit $1000/person required within 3 days of booking, payable to the DSU Heritage Foundation.

Please note that checks are preferred, and credit card transactions will incur a $75 fee per person.

Final payment is due on September 1, 2026

For more information or to register for this amazing opportunity to travel with friends—and help support the Blue Hawk Scholarship Fund in the process—please visit www.dsualum.org/cruise To book and customize your preferences, please call Kay at All American Travel: 701‑225‑6801 or 1‑800‑732‑7075. Questions: Contact Robyn McChesney at (701) 483-2486 or Kay at All American Travel (701)225-6801 or 1-800-732-7075
